TRAFFIC ADVISORY: UNDAS 2025
The Makati Public Safety Department will implement road closures and traffic rerouting from October 31 to November 2, 2025, in observance of Undas.
Motorists are advised to plan their trips ahead and take alternate routes to avoid traffic congestion.
